# Idira Receiver

Polls the Idira SIEM integration stream API for audit events and emits them as logs.

## Overview

The Idira receiver polls the Idira SIEM integration stream API for audit events and emits them as
logs. Each poll performs the documented two-step call sequence:

1. `POST /api/audits/stream/createQuery` with a date-filtered query, which returns a `cursorRef`.
2. `POST /api/audits/stream/results` with that `cursorRef`, repeated with the cursor from each
   response until a page comes back empty.

Requests are authenticated with an OAuth 2 client credentials token from the Identity
Administration token endpoint (refreshed automatically) plus the SIEM integration API key.

Each audit event becomes one log record whose body is the event object; the record timestamp is
taken from the event's `timestamp` field.

## Configuration

| Field | Default | Description |
| ----- | ------- | ----------- |
| `endpoint` | required | Audit API base URL, e.g. `https://audit.example.cloud`. |
| `api_key` | required | SIEM integration API key, sent as the `x-api-key` header. |
| `token_url` | required | OAuth 2 token endpoint, `https://<identity_fqdn>/OAuth2/Token/<web_app_id>`. |
| `client_id` | required | OAuth 2 client ID. |
| `client_secret` | required | OAuth 2 client secret. |
| `scopes` | `[isp.audit.events:read]` | OAuth 2 scopes requested for the token. |
| `poll_interval` | `1m` | How often a query is created. The API accepts one query per minute, so values below `1m` are rejected. |
| `initial_lookback` | `5m` | How far back the first poll queries when no checkpoint is stored. |
| `page_size` | `500` | Events per results page. |
| `application_codes` | unset | Restrict the query to these application codes, e.g. `[DPA]`. |
| `storage` | unset | ID of a [storage extension](../../extension/storage/filestorage/README.md) used to keep the checkpoint across collector restarts. Without it, a restart resumes from `initial_lookback`. |

All [confighttp client settings](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector/blob/main/config/confighttp/README.md)
are also supported, such as `timeout` (default `30s`), `tls` and `proxy_url`.

### Example

```yaml
extensions:
  file_storage:

receivers:
  idira:
    endpoint: https://audit.example.cloud
    api_key: ${env:IDIRA_API_KEY}
    token_url: https://identity.example.cloud/OAuth2/Token/web_app_id
    client_id: ${env:IDIRA_CLIENT_ID}
    client_secret: ${env:IDIRA_CLIENT_SECRET}
    poll_interval: 1m
    application_codes: [DPA]
    storage: file_storage

service:
  extensions: [file_storage]
  pipelines:
    logs:
      receivers: [idira]
      exporters: [debug]
```

## Delivery semantics

The date filter has one-second granularity, so each poll starts its query at the end of the
previous one rather than one second later. Events on that boundary second can be delivered twice;
deduplicate on the event `uuid` downstream if that matters.
